metadata.description: Skills and agents for Claude Code: autonomous codebase overhaul, docs/i18n sync, publishing prep, a set of creative-frontend specialist agents, and an adversarial security auditor for AI-generated codebases.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Five general-purpose skills: full-project-rework (autonomous multi-agent codebase overhaul), project-refresh (docs, deployment info and i18n sync), generalize (strip personal context before publishing), list-skills (compact skill inventory), erklaerbaer (bilingual plain-language explainer).

plugins.name: creative-frontend
plugins.description: Five specialist agents for GPU-heavy creative frontends: GPU fluid simulation, GLSL print-media rendering, WebGL performance budgeting, motion plus accessibility, and i18n/copy stewardship. Each ships a replaceable PROJECT GROUND TRUTH block.

plugins.name: security-audit
plugins.description: One adversarial security, safety and production-readiness reviewer specialized in AI-generated codebases: RLS and client-to-database exposure, secrets in bundles, missing server-side authorization, slopsquatted dependencies, the lethal trifecta, and destructive-action guardrails. Ships an optional hook that enforces its read-only guarantee.
